concerns.text: FR-003 requires Pearson correlation coefficients, but no task in tasks.md computes Pearson r; the only correlation task (T020) implements Spearman ρ.
FR-005 mandates a Bonferroni correction (α = 0.001), yet the only multiple‑comparison task (T023) applies Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR, leaving the Bonferroni requirement uncovered.
FR-008 specifies flagging trait‑genre pairs where |Pearson r| > 0.3, but no task addresses this flag for Pearson correlations (the existing flag in T020 is for Spearman ρ).
SC-002 expects significance measured against a Bonferroni‑adjusted p‑value threshold of 0.001; no task provides such adjusted p‑values (T023 uses BH FDR).

Task T040 proposes amending Principle VI to replace Bonferroni with FDR, which conflicts with the constitution’s Statistical Transparency principle and the spec’s FR‑005; this amendment should be removed or re‑evaluated.
